newsitem.title: UK: Algeria raises gas oil premium in Aug - trade.
newsitem.headline: Algeria raises gas oil premium in Aug - trade.

text.p: Algerian state oil company Sonatrach has raised its asking price for low sulphur gas oil to be delivered in August, traders said on Monday.
Sonatrach was looking for a premium of $1.50 to the formula, which is based on diesel prices in northern Europe and the Mediterranean, they said.
Sonatrach obtained a $1 discount to the formula in July.
The company is expected to deliver seven or eight cargoes in August, around two less than in July.
